tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya'i dbu rtse'i bla ma lha khang gi rten gsar bzhengs sogs kyi gzungs rdzong gi dkar chag bzhugs pas dge'o// na mo gu ru ṭi ṇi ye/ gser 'phyang zhes pa me mo bya lo dpal sa skya'i dbu rtse'i bla ma lha khang gi rten gsar bzhengs sogs kyi gzungs rdzong gi bzhugs tshul dkar chag tu bkod pa la thog mar rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sku mi tshad ma la/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / gdung rten me zhabs ma skyon med/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rin gyis gsar bzhengs dang phyag nas smin rgyas mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi gser sku rkang gang pa/ sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag nas thugs dam ma'i birwa pa'i bris thang / sngags 'chang chen po'i dbu lo'i zegs ma phon che ba/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsol phod rnga mo ga pa'i spu'i ther ma las grub pa rgyan gzhi nang dar dang bcas pa bubs ma nyams pa/ dri bsung khyad par can dang ldan pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la lam 'bras brgyud pas bskor ba'i bris thang yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel gyi phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs pa/ tshe dpag med kyi bris thang brgya tshar ma gnyis/ rje btsun gong ma lnga re res gtso bo byas pa'i bris thang chung ngu lnga la lam 'bras brgyud pa yongs rdzogs kyis bskor ba bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi skabs tsam gyi shin tu byin rlabs che ba lnga/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum gyi dam rdzas brgya rdo/ bcu rdo/ sil ma'i thum/ thub dbang gnas bcus bskor ba dang / kyai rdor dkyil thang rnying ma re re/ sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan gyi shangs phyis bubs bcu gsum/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i sku rags bubs ma nyams pa sku dreg can lnga/ stod smad bar gsum gyi gzungs sngags rgyas pa cha tshang dang bcas pa bzhugs shing / ༈ /sngags 'chang chen po'i sku mi tshad tsam la/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / gdung rten dkar mo skyon med/

stod smad bar gsum gyi gzungs sngags rgyas pa cha tshang / sngags 'chang chen po'i dbu lo stobs che ba/ yang sngags 'chang de nyid kyi rgyun bzhes kyi sku bem gyi nang bubs ma nyams pa dri bzang khyad par can dang ldan pa dang / sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan gyi shangs phyis bubs ma nyams pa bcu gcig sngags 'chang yab sras gsum gyi dam rdzas brgya rdo bcu rdo sil ma'i thum/ sa lo chen pos bzhi thog tshoms dmar du lam 'bras gnang dus/ der skabs kyi slob ma zhig gis ched gtad bzhengs pa'i sa lo nyid la/ lam 'bras brgyud pas bskor ba la sa lo'i phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs pa'i bris thang gcig yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i gtso bo sngags 'chang chen po la/ birwa pa/ gong ma lnga/ sa lo/ 'jam dbyangs sku mched sogs 'dod lha mang pos bskor ba'i bris thang la/ sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag nas brgya tshar bzhugs nges kyi byin rlabs can gcig tshar chen gtso bo la 'khor rang 'dra zhe gnyis dang / steng du rdo ring pa/ gzhan yang tshe dpag med/ mgon dkar/ bram gzugs/ rnam sras sogs kyis bskor ba'i bris thang tshar chen rang gi phyag nas ma bzhi/ tshe dpag med stong tshar gyi bris thang rnying ma/ sgrol dkar brgya tshar ma gcig rje 'gyur med bde chen gyi bris thang lo chen sprul skus bzhengs pa la rje 'gyur med kyi phyag nas bzhugs nges pa gcig rnams bzhugs/ yang nged rang gi 'dra 'bag dbu rtse mthil gyi lam 'bras brgyud pa'i kha skong du bzhengs pa la/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / mchod rten rgya dkar ma spus gtsang gcig stod smad bar gsum gyi gzungs sngags rgyas pa cha tshang ba/ sngags 'chang chen po'i dbu lo'i dbu snyigs la dbu tshab che ba mdzad pa bubs ma nyams pa/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum gyi dam rdzas brgya rdo/ bcu rdo/ sil ma'i thum/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyi sku 'dra li khra mkhan chen de nyid rang gi phyag nas ma gcig

tshe dpag med kyi bris thang brgya tshar ma lo chen ratna bha dra'i phyag nas ma gcig spyan ras gzigs la dmar khrid brgyud pas bskor ba'i bris thang gcig sgrol dkar gyi bris thang stong tshar ma gcig yang sgrol dkar gtso bo la rang 'dra nyer gcig gis bskor ba'i bris thang gcig yang tshe dpag med kyi gser thang brgya tshar ma gcig rje tshar chen gyi bris thang rang 'dra zhe gnyis kyis bskor ba/ 'dod lha mang po dang bcas pa tshar chen nyid kyi phyag nas bzhugs nges cha/ chos rje sa paṇa gtso bo la rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs 'dod lha mang pos bskor ba sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag nas bzhugs nges gcig bla ma gong ma'i spur dar la bzhengs pa'i thub dbang brgya tshar gyi bris thang gcig sngags 'chang chen po phebs 'grul gnang dus kyi dbu zhwa bubs ma nyams pa/ sku char gyi dum bu che ba/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i sku shag bubs ma nyams pa/ yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can gyi sku bem bubs ma nyams pa rnams dri bsung khyad par can dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam mthar phyin nas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gros mdun bsus nas/ /bar do'i 'jigs skrag snang ba mi mthong bar/ /mkha' spyod bde ldan mngon dga'i zhing sogs su/ /thogs med bgrod de don gnyis mthar phyin shog /de skad smra ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can te/ /yi ge pa ni dpyod ldan mi'i dbang po/ /rnam rgyal rdo rjes phyag sor 'phrul las bskrun/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ sa skya'i dbu rtse'i bla ma lha khang gi rten gsar bzhengs sogs kyi gzungs rdzong gi dkar chag
